pages.title: Gravitic Lens Element
pages.text: A dark-matter lens trimmed so its Einstein ring falls exactly where it is needed. Gravitational lensing bends light from distant objects into rings and arcs; this one is tuned to focus gravity on a chosen point. It looks like a faint distortion in empty air.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Metamaterial Weaver I trimmed a Dark Matter Lens with Metamaterial Sheet and Entangled Photon Pairs to measure the focus. Adjusting the Dark Matter, the Einstein ring settled exactly where I wanted it.
